finding: Commit 28ec0830 adds four rules to the Feature merge paragraph of docs/spec/interface-contracts.md § premerge-check, and no Scenario of run-lifecycle.feature traces any of them. First, the feature merge refuses when the ledger of the run is missing or cannot be read. Second, it refuses a pending unit of work that no return holds back (BR-113, IMPL-0050). Third, it refuses when docs/testing.yaml at the feature branch head has no test_command. Fourth, it runs for the target refs/heads/dev, applies no file limit without --max-files, and prints the SKIP line for the file limit. The QA strategy has no row for these rules either. tests/factory/test_run_lifecycle_premerge.py covers the pending case under RL-13-IT-01 and the target refs/heads/dev, but no test covers the missing ledger or the missing test_command. Add the first three cases as rows to the Scenario Outline 'premerge-check dev refuses a run that is not ready', and add one Scenario for the target refs/heads/dev and the file limit. Owner: requirements-agent. The test-strategy agent then adds the matching QA rows.
why_this_severity: The contract and premerge-check agree on each rule, so an implementer and a test writer who follow the contract reach the right behavior (no to fails_purpose); a reader who looks for these refusals in the feature file or the QA strategy finds nothing and must turn to the contract (raises_cost). No story or code outside the run encodes the statements.
